query: Please implement a web application framework that uses annotations for configuration. The framework should be able to replace traditional web.xml configuration files, allowing developers to use annotations to define servlets, filters, and other web components. Users should be able to use annotations to configure routing, request methods, parameters, and other information, and the framework should be able to automatically scan and register these annotations. Set page background to moonstone; color all components with steel blue.
